title: Just SYBAU
description: Client-side chat category filter that lets you turn off chat partially
body:
# Just SYBAU

`Just SYBAU` is a **client-side Fabric mod** that gives you full control over which chat messages you see in Minecraft.

You can hide specific categories of chat instantly, open a clean vanilla-style menu, assign your own shortcuts, clear chat with a custom key, and review hidden messages in a built-in archive.

No server install is required.

## Features

- 100% client-side (works on vanilla servers and modded servers)
- Live toggles (no restart needed)
- Filter categories:
  - Command output (`/say`, `/tellraw`, command feedback, etc.)
  - Private messages (`/msg`, `/tell`, `/w`)
  - User chat (normal player messages)
  - Join/leave messages
  - Death/kill messages
  - Command block output
- Open menu with command: `/justsybau`
- Customizable shortcuts inside the GUI:
  - Open menu key (default: `None`)
  - Clear chat key (default: `None`)
- Filtered message archive:
  - Read past messages that were hidden by filters
  - Scrollable history view
  - Clear archive button
- Clean vanilla-style UI

## Requirements

- Minecraft: `1.21.11`
- Fabric Loader: `0.18.6+`
- Fabric API: `0.141.3+1.21.11` (or compatible)
- Java: `21+`

## Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft `1.21.11`.
2. Put Fabric API into your `mods` folder.
3. Put `just-sybau-1.0.0.jar` into your `mods` folder.
4. Start Minecraft.

## Quick Tutorial

### 1) Open the menu

Use:

```mcfunction
/justsybau
```

### 2) Toggle chat categories

- In the menu, each button controls one message type.
- `ON` means visible.
- `OFF` means hidden.
- Changes apply instantly.

### 3) Set custom shortcuts

- In the same menu, click `Open Menu Key` or `Clear Chat Key`.
- Press any keyboard key or mouse button.
- Press `ESC` while assigning to reset it to `None`.

### 4) Read hidden messages

- Click `View Filtered Messages`.
- Scroll with mouse wheel or arrow keys.
- Use `Clear Stored Messages` if you want to wipe history.

## Notes

- This mod only changes what **you** see.
- It does not block, edit, or modify server messages.
- It does not require the server to have the mod.

## Troubleshooting

### The menu does not open

- Confirm you are using `/justsybau` (with slash).
- Make sure the correct jar is in the `mods` folder.
- Confirm game version and Fabric API match the requirements.

### Filters seem not to work

- Check each category button state (`OFF` = filtered).
- Some custom server/plugin formats may not match perfectly.
- If needed, open an issue with logs and an example message format.

### Game crashes or UI conflicts

- Update Fabric Loader and Fabric API.
- Test with only Fabric API + Just SYBAU to confirm conflict source.
